opendecider-nano.machine: Intel Core 7 150U, 12 threads, 15 GB RAM, no GPU, Linux on WSL2
opendecider-nano.notes: One call per ticket with the three questions; latency is the judge call only (model load excluded). Wall time of the whole run: 217 s including model load.

xgboost-tfidf.setup: TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 2), sublinear_tf=True); XGBClassifier(n_estimators=120, max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.1); 5-fold stratified out-of-fold, random_state=14, one model per question, no tuning

gemma-12b.model: Gemma 12B served by Ollama, general chat model prompted for JSON with probabilities
gemma-12b.device: the author's GPU machine (not this one)
gemma-12b.provenance: Copied from an earlier run of the benchmark in the building-llm-applications repository (chapter 14, 2026-11-02); not re-run for this repository. Interrupted after 49 of 120 tickets (ids 0-48, template-built only); 2 tickets failed because the model never produced an answer for the refund question on tickets with a negation.

not_measured: GGUF builds through Ollama or LM Studio
